n: Pokémon Center Osaka DX & Pokémon Café
address: Daimaru Shinsaibashi Main Bldg 9F, 1-7-1 Shinsaibashi-suji, Chuo-ku, Osaka 〒542-8501
w: Western Japan's only permanent Pokémon Café (opened 20 Sept 2019 with the DX store): Pikachu curry, Eevee pancakes and Pokéball desserts, reservation-only; reopened June 2026 after a renewal.
anime: Pokémon — the Pokémon Company's own café and DX-format store, one of only two Pokémon Cafés in Japan

w: The third permanent Kirby Café (opened 21 Nov 2024) with Osaka-only dishes — a Waddle Dee okonomiyaki burger, kushikatsu in an Inhaling Kirby bowl, takoyaki-style petit cakes; reservations sell out months ahead.
anime: Kirby (Nintendo / HAL Laboratory) — official permanent Kirby Café with an Osaka-exclusive kuidaore menu
